name: KronPolicyAnchor
desc: Policy Anchor and Cryptographic Audit Contract for Autonomous AI Agents on Algorand. Every KRON payment is an atomic transaction group containing an app call to this contract (anchoring a SHA-256 policy decision hash) and a payment transaction. Both land atomically in ~3.3s or neither does.

methods.name: anchor_policy
methods.desc: Anchors a SHA-256 policy decision hash and registers the economic execution record (agent ID + amount). Rejected if emergency_stop is engaged.

args.name: policy_hash
args.desc: SHA-256 hash of the deterministic policy decision

args.name: amount_micro
args.desc: MicroAlgo or base asset unit value settled

methods.name: get_payment_count
methods.desc: Returns the total count of verified payments settled and anchored under this contract instance.

methods.name: get_last_policy_hash
methods.desc: Returns the latest anchored policy hash (raw SHA-256 digest, 32 bytes).

methods.name: get_agent_policy_hash
methods.desc: Returns the most recently anchored policy hash for a specific agent from per-agent box storage (key: ag:<agent_id>).

methods.name: set_emergency_stop
methods.desc: Creator-only freeze switch. When engaged (true), all future anchor_policy calls are rejected — no payments can be anchored on-chain until the creator releases the stop.

args.name: stopped
args.desc: True engages the emergency stop, false releases it

methods.name: flush
methods.desc: Creator-only inner transaction — forwards the application's entire ALGO balance back to the creator address via an inner payment transaction.
